title: MTS Trade Plan
description: One trade idea for the Deribit execution layer (T050). Compiled by plan_compiler.py into an order list, executed by executor.py. Defaults below are conservative starting caps per T050 dependency list; operator raises them after phase 4 (reconciliation) proves stable, not before.

account.description: Deribit subaccount name/label this plan trades on. Single-account only in phase 1-5; multi-account is step 6.

instrument.description: Phase 1 scope is BTC-PERPETUAL only. Widening this enum is a deliberate later decision, not a default.

max_hold_minutes.description: Optional time exit: position_manager closes the position (reduce-only market, close first, then cancels stop/targets) once this many minutes have elapsed since the entry fill.

breakeven_after_first_target.description: Optional R2 runner exit (needs >= 2 targets): position_manager edits the stop trigger to the average entry fill once the first target order is completely filled. Omit to disable. Not the stop.type breakeven_after_fills, which means ladder rungs and stays refused by executor.

end.description: ISO-8601 UTC. Plan expires (not executed / entry cancelled) after this.

price.description: Required when type=limit. Ignored for market. Not used for ladder (use range).

range.description: Required when type=ladder. low < high; rungs are distributed across this range.

rungs.description: Required when type=ladder. Max 10 pending Opus confirmation (T050 dependency: ladder size cap not yet set).

size_multipliers.description: Required when type=ladder. Length must equal rungs. Each multiplier scales base_unit for that rung.

base_unit.description: Base contract size (USD-denominated, BTC-PERPETUAL is inverse). Rounded to $10 increments by the compiler.

min_fills_for_breakeven.description: Required when type=breakeven_after_fills. Stop moves to average entry once this many rungs have filled.

targets.description: Optional. Sum of amount_percent across all targets must not exceed 100 (validator-enforced, not schema-enforced - JSON Schema can't sum across array items).

max_notional_usd.description: Hard ceiling on this plan's total notional. Schema max of $10,000 is the conservative T050 default; operator raises after phase 4 proves stable.

max_loss_usd.description: Hard ceiling on this plan's worst-case realized loss (negative number). Schema floor of -$500 is the conservative T050 default.

max_concurrent_orders.description: Entry rungs + stop + targets combined must not exceed this. Conservative default cap is 10.

signal_ref.description: Optional. Free-text reference to the MTS rule/condition that produced this plan, e.g. 'T040-tick-delta' or 'manual-operator'. Decoupled from signal source by design - trade-plan validity does not depend on this field.
